title: Port settlement registration and live callback iteration
scope: Complete registerSettle function identity, explicit unsubscribe and live Set iteration, composing the settlement wait component. Preserve deletion/addition/re-addition during callbacks and old unsubscribe behavior.
acceptance: Full original registry graph compares live registration mutation, exact callback order/arguments and complete wait states.
Finite metadata/reentrancy bounds, owned subscriptions and non-Clone failures; full existing stable settlement corpus remains required.
open_items: Actual executor must retain/drain started work; browser promise turns, full registry command wiring and runtime cancellation/termination remain separate.
Owned immutable metadata excludes arbitrary JS getters/prototype replacement; ordinary Rust Arc/Rc allocation is not process-wide OOM isolation.
